nlohmann/json 3.11.3 — single header, MIT (license text in json.hpp).
Source: https://github.com/nlohmann/json, release 3.11.3; copied unchanged from
StageHand's vendored copy (`external/nlohmann/json.hpp`), so the projects use
the same version. Used only by `src/App/SessionFile.cpp` to read and write
`session.json` (docs/files.md).
